parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: The part of the closed disc centre $4+2i$ and radius $3$ lying on or to the right of $\operatorname{Re}(z)=5$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: show a circle with centre 4 + 2i. B1: show radius 3 with centre not at the origin. B1: show the straight line Re(z) = 5. B1: shade the correct region; allow even if the radius mark was not gained or the radius was shown incorrectly. If 4 and 6 are shown on the real axis and the line is at their midpoint but 5 is not marked, allow the final two B1 marks. [Total: 4]

parts.label: (b)

steps.working: complete a method for the greatest arg z, e.g. $\tan^{-1}((2 + 2\sqrt{2})/5)$; allow $2\sqrt{2}$ as $\sqrt{3^2 - 1^2}$
